content.name: Haste
entries: Choose a willing creature that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, the target's speed is doubled, it gains a +2 bonus to AC, it has advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and it gains an additional action on each of its turns. That action can be used only to take the {@action Attack} (one weapon attack only), {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage}, {@action Hide}, or {@action Use an Object} action.
When the spell ends, the target can't move or take actions until after its next turn, as a wave of lethargy sweeps over it.

content.name: Haste
entries: Choose a willing creature that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, the target's {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} is doubled, it gains a +2 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52}, it has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on Dexterity saving throws, and it gains an additional action on each of its turns. That action can be used to take only the {@action Attack|SRD52} (one attack only), {@action Dash|SRD52}, {@action Disengage|SRD52}, {@action Hide|SRD52}, or {@action Utilize|SRD52} action.
When the spell ends, the target is {@condition Incapacitated|SRD52} and has a {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} of 0 until the end of its next turn, as a wave of lethargy washes over it.
